Adds an optional **Use ISO week numbers** setting for `odd-weeks`, `even-weeks` and `every-n-weeks`. Your schedules don't change unless you untick it.

### Why
ISO week numbers restart at 1 every year. 2026 has 53 weeks, and week 53 and week 1 are both odd, so on this New Year the cadence jumps:
- **`odd-weeks`:** collects on 28 Dec and again on 4 Jan.
- **`even-weeks`:** skips from 21 Dec to 11 Jan.

That's correct if your council schedules by week number, and a week off from January if they simply collect fortnightly.

### The setting
- **Ticked (default):** ISO week numbers, exactly as before. Existing sensors don't have the setting stored and count as ticked, so their dates don't change. A test compares every week-based schedule against the previous calculation across 2020–2040 and requires identical dates.
- **Unticked:** a strict every-n-weeks cadence that continues across New Year. It's numbered like the ISO weeks of 2026, so both settings give the same dates until the end of 2026. You can switch at any time before your last collection of December.

To change it, go to *Settings → Devices & services → Helpers*, open the helper, choose **Configure** and click through to the second step.
